name: Kyon: Big Damn Hero
source: A Tvtropes website/Haruhi crossover. Kyon with a beam saber. Haruhi aware of her powers. An unsubtle harem plot. Did I mention the Higurashi crossover? Now say it with a straight face - I dare you.
translation: 一部Tvtropes网站/凉宫春日的跨界作品。阿虚拿着光剑。春日意识到了自己的能力。毫不掩饰的后宫剧情。我有没有提到《寒蝉鸣泣之时》的跨界？现在你能面不改色地说出来吗——我向你挑战。
